summary: Verified BUG fix (ReceiptBookUpdate allows clearing assigned_to via null) and NEW FEATURE (AddChanda auto-selects last-used book and auto-fills next receipt number). Backend and Settings edit work fully. Auto-select on load works. However, changing the receipt book via the dropdown does NOT update the receipt-no input as required by the feature spec.

integration_issues.issue: When user changes the receipt book via the <select> (data-testid=add-receipt-book-select), the receipt number input (add-receipt-no-input) is NOT updated to the new book's next available number. It keeps the previously auto-filled value (e.g. stays '52' after switching from Book 2 to Book 1 whose next is 4). Root cause in /app/frontend/src/pages/AddChanda.jsx lines 87-94: the effect uses `setReceiptNo((prev) => (prev ? prev : String(r.next)))` which preserves any existing value including the auto-filled one. Comment even says 'Always auto-fill next receipt number when book changes' but implementation doesn't do that. Suggestion: track whether receipt_no was user-edited (e.g. a ref flag) and always overwrite on book change if not user-edited, OR unconditionally setReceiptNo(String(r.next)) on book change.

action_items: Fix AddChanda receipt-no auto-update on receipt-book change (see integration_issues). The auto-select-on-load and initial auto-fill both work; only the on-change behavior regressed / never worked as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: AddChanda.jsx L87-94: `setReceiptNo((prev) => (prev ? prev : String(r.next)))` cannot distinguish auto-filled vs user-typed values, so changing book never updates receipt_no. Use a ref (userEditedRef) toggled onChange of the input to gate updates.
server.py update_receipt_book correctly distinguishes required scalars vs nullable fields; consider adding same pattern to other update endpoints if they need to clear nullable fields.
seed_data_creation: Created and immediately voided one test chanda (TEST_regression, id 593737bc-...) in Book 2 receipt 52 to validate regression. DB restored: Book 2 assigned_to=Shrikant, next=52.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bug fix for ReceiptBookUpdate (allowing null for assigned_to/note) verified via curl and UI. Auto-select last-used book + auto-fill next receipt number on /add page load verified (Book 2 pre-selected, receipt_no=52 for the current DB state where latest chanda is Book2 #51). Only remaining defect: switching book via dropdown does not update receipt_no because AddChanda useEffect preserves any existing (even auto-filled) value.
rca of the issue: AddChanda.jsx uses `setReceiptNo((prev) => (prev ? prev : String(r.next)))` inside the [receiptBookId] effect. On mount the input is empty so it fills correctly; on user changing the book, `prev` is the previous auto-filled number ('52') so the branch keeps it. Fix: introduce `userEditedNoRef` set true only in the input's onChange handler, and in the effect do `if (!userEditedNoRef.current && r.next != null) setReceiptNo(String(r.next))`.
